notes: Student edition: replaced Flashcards and Citation Generator with two widgets students actually use every day. Class Schedule is a weekly Mon–Fri grid with editable cells (subject + room), auto-default 7-period times, and the current period highlighted in gold based on the time of day. Grade Tracker shows per-class current grade percentage and letter from logged assignments (score / total), with overall average tinted by performance (green ≥90, gold ≥80, orange ≥70, red below). Existing Student installs that had Flashcards or Citation in their layout will see the new defaults — Class Schedule in the wide slot, Grade Tracker in the small slot beside GPA.
